title: Bright Leaf by Foster Fitz-Simons Hardcover 1948 Rinehart & Co., Inc.
descriptionText:
This antique book titled "Bright Leaf" by Foster Fitz-Simons is a rare find for any book collector. The hardcover edition was printed by Rinehart & Company in the United States in 1948. The book is written in English and falls under the category of literature and fiction. 

The book's binding is intact and shows some signs of wear which is expected given its age. The author's name is clearly printed on the cover and the title is easily readable. This book is a great addition to any collection and a must-have for lovers of antique literature.
